customManagers.description: The images the container tests use, Meilisearch and Garage, each of which must match compose.yaml's.
The pnpm the Dockerfiles install, which must match packageManager in package.json.

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 ships no JS API, which vue-tsc and typescript-eslint depend on. Stay on 6.x until they support 7 (pnpm-workspace.yaml).
@types/node follows the Node major in .node-version. Raise this with it.
Node's version: .node-version and both Dockerfiles' base image.
engines is a range, raised by hand with a new Node major: until then, pnpm refuses to install, so CI fails.
pnpm: packageManager in package.json, and the Dockerfiles. A test fails if they differ.
The Meilisearch image, in compose.yaml and search/testing.ts. A test fails if the two differ.
The Garage image, in compose.yaml and blobs/testing.ts. A test fails if the two differ.
ESLint and its plugins and configs.
The actions the CI workflow uses.
Only releases at least a week old (CLAUDE.md, Dependencies). Last, so it overrides config:best-practices' 3 days for npm.
